title: Pages with no text: unreadable issues, and no facts from them
about: Page 2 of the stability report is an image with no text. scan-0007.pdf is one image page. The site is named only in that scan, and the long-term table is only on stability page 2.

pages:
Summary of Product Characteristics (draft, sections 1 to 6)

1. Name of the medicinal product

Marixan 5 mg tablets

2. Qualitative and quantitative composition

Each tablet contains 5 mg of marixan.

3. Pharmaceutical form

Film-coated tablet. White, oval, biconvex tablets.

6.3 Shelf life

The shelf life of the medicinal product is 24 months.

6.4 Special precautions for storage

Do not store above 30 C.

6.5 Nature and contents of container

PVC/PVDC-Alu blisters in cartons of 30 tablets.

Stability report: Marixan 5 mg tablets

The results for the three primary batches are presented on page 2 (Table 1) and discussed on page 3.

3.2.P.8.1 Conclusion

All results stayed within specification. A shelf life of 24 months is proposed when the product is stored below 30 C in the original package.

3.2.P.3 Manufacture

The name and address of the manufacturing site are given in the attached good manufacturing practice certificate. The process is direct compression followed by blister packing.
